title: Identity
description: The Living Identity (0002 §1) — the immortal thread. Memory is keyed to the DID, never to the process. Includes Attachment (session binding) and Transfer (governed re-scope with source veto + ancestor override, locked 2026-07-01).

lineage.description: → its archetype if this is an instance; null for an archetype/root identity.

facts.description: AgentFacts — W3C VC: declared capabilities + runtime-earned evaluations (0006 §5). Never self-asserted.

resident.description: true = TCB roster (steward, governance, analysis, becky); false = registered workforce. Residents author floors; workforce never governs its own tuning.

born_at.description: An identity is born in the universe's life — the League's rookie is born in season 3, not on a Tuesday (0004 §1).

Attachment.description: A running process attaches to an identity for a session; detaches on offline. Reboot ≠ death (0002 §1).

Transfer.description: Governed re-scope (0002 §1). Portable memory follows; branch-bound stays. Locked 2026-07-01: the source scope must release (its authority appears in approved_by); a common ancestor may override the source veto — signed, on the record.

approved_by.description: source authority + destination authority + identity owner

ancestor_override.description: Present only when a common ancestor overrides the source veto.

at.description: The authorization is a control-plane act (wall); the trade's place in the universe's story is carried by the memory records about it (occurred_at).
